initialize_MMdetHandler: initialize the MMdetHandler class to load an object detection model from a config file and checkpoint
preprocess_MMdetHandler: preprocess base64-encoded image data into numpy arrays for object detection inference
inference_MMdetHandler: run inference_detector on preprocessed images using the loaded mmdet model
postprocess_MMdetHandler: postprocess inference results into a list of detected objects with class names, bboxes, and scores above threshold
build_object_detection_handler: build a TorchServe handler for mmdet object detection that accepts images and returns bounding box predictions
